subject: Recap: Discovery + Proposed Pilot Charter for SentryEdge evaluation
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@sentryedge.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@sentryedge.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Discovery + Proposed Pilot Charter for SentryEdge evaluation

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap while it’s fresh and a proposed pilot charter so we can lock dates and owners. TL;DR: strong fit for a short 6-week evaluation focused on latency-sensitive document classification and cost reduction via batching/caching.

Pain points you shared:
- High inference cost on current vendor for bursty traffic (esp. end-of-month processing).
- Inconsistent latency at 99th percentile impacting downstream UX.
- Lack of visibility into per-route token costs and model drift alerts.

Goals for the pilot:
1) Reduce per-request cost by >=25% on classification workload at target throughput.
2) Meet 99th percentile latency <= 350ms for median document size (avg 240 tokens).
3) Demonstrate stable quality (F1 within 2 points of current baseline) using our prompt-eval harness.

Proposed pilot scope (attached: pilot-charter-sentryedge-v1.pdf):
- Duration: 6 weeks (2 week prep + 4 week active eval)
- Workloads: batch classification job (nightly) + low-latency API for interactive review (peak 120 rps)
- Success metrics: cost per 1k tokens, p50/p95/p99 latency, classifier F1 on shared evaluation set
- Owners: Sofia (Redwood) — technical lead; Kimberly (Redwood) — evaluation metrics & prompt suites; Marcus (Redwood) — infra/ops. Your side: Alex (ML lead) — eval dataset & ground truth; Priya — procurement & PO owner.
- Access required: service account for S3 bucket read, IAM role for test env, sample dataset upload location. See access-checklist-sentryedge.xlsx for specifics.

Next steps I propose this week:
- You confirm acceptance of scope and owners (this thread) — target: Mon 15 Mar
- We deliver pilot-charter v2 (incorporate any timeline/metric tweaks) — target: Tue 16 Mar
- Kickoff call & environment handoff — target: Thu 18 Mar

Open items we need from you:
- Procurement contact + PO timeline (if applicable)
- SOC 2 / security questionnaire (I’ve attached our standard — if you have your own, send it over)

Attachments: pilot-charter-sentryedge-v1.pdf, access-checklist-sentryedge.xlsx, security-questionnaire-sentryedge.docx

If anything above is incorrect or missing, flag it and I’ll update the charter before v2. Thanks — looking forward to moving forward.

Best,

Sofia Ivanova
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Redwood Inference — inference that scales predictably

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@sentryedge.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@sentryedge.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + Proposed Pilot Charter for SentryEdge evaluation

Thanks Sofia — great summary and aligned on the goals. A couple of notes / clarifications: 

- Timeline: can we move the kickoff to Mon 22 Mar instead of the 18th? We have a quarter-end cutover week the 15th–19th.
- Success metrics: we care most about p99 latency during peak ingest windows (00:00–02:00 UTC) and cost per classification at 95%ile throughput, if you can capture that specifically.
- Procurement: looping in procurement@ (procurement@sentryedge.ai) for PO timelines. Priya will lead contract/PO.

On security: we’ll send over our standard vendor questionnaire. Can you also confirm whether Redwood is open to an IP/data handling addendum for our test data?

One ask from Alex (ML): we’ll provide the eval set by next Tue (16 Mar) but note there will be redaction/PII masking steps on our side; can you confirm if Redwood can run on data with masked identifiers and still produce reliable F1 metrics?

Thanks — Alex

Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + Proposed Pilot Charter for SentryEdge evaluation

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks for the quick notes. We’re flexible on the kickoff; Mon 22 Mar works for the Redwood team. I’ve updated the pilot charter to reflect the p99-focused metric and the revised kickoff date (attached: pilot-charter-sentryedge-v2.pdf). High-level responses to your asks below: 

- p99 during peak ingest: we’ll add a dedicated test window simulation for 00:00–02:00 UTC and report p50/p95/p99 for that window as part of the deliverables.
- Cost measurement: we’ll capture cost per 1k classifications at 95th percentile throughput and include per-route token-level breakdowns in the dashboard.
- Data handling / IP addendum: Redwood can sign a limited data handling addendum for evaluation-only datasets. I’ll loop in legal if you want a draft; we typically sign a short clause that prevents model training on customer eval datasets and limits retention to the pilot window.
- Masked identifiers: yes — running on redacted IDs is fine. Our eval harness computes F1 against your ground truth labels and is resilient to identifier redaction (we key on label alignment).

Action items I’ll take on now:
- Send pilot-charter v2 (attached) — done
- Create Drive folder & share access link — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-sentryedge-pilot (shared with Alex/Priya)
- Set calendar hold for kickoff Mon 22 Mar 10:00am PT (invite to follow)

Kimberly / Marcus — flagged for visibility on the evaluation plan & access steps.

Priya / procurement@sentryedge.ai — can you confirm PO lead and target PO date so we can prep invoicing details? If you prefer DocuSign for the SOW, we can route via https://www.docusign.com/en/SE-2027-0312-01-DocuSign.

Best,

Sofia
